tasks.title: Cargo.toml: dependencies & metadata
tasks.description: Update Cargo.toml with all required dependencies: clap (derive feature), rusqlite (or equivalent for storage), and any web framework needed for the serve subcommand. Sets edition, version, and binary name.

tasks.title: Storage: data types & error definitions
tasks.description: Define the core `Bookmark` struct and `StorageError` enum used by the storage layer and consumed by the CLI. Placed in `src/storage/types.rs`.

tasks.title: Storage: SQLite backend
tasks.description: Implement `src/storage/mod.rs` with the `Storage` struct that opens/creates a SQLite database at a given path, and exposes `add`, `list`, and `remove` methods. Errors map to `StorageError`. Default path resolves to `~/.markman.db`.

tasks.title: Web: serve stub
tasks.description: Implement `src/web/mod.rs` with a `serve` function that binds to the given port, prints the listening message to stdout, and blocks serving requests. Handles port-already-in-use error by printing to stderr and exiting with code 1.

tasks.title: CLI: argument definitions via clap derive
tasks.description: Implement `src/cli.rs` defining the top-level `Cli` struct and `Commands` enum (add, list, remove, serve) using clap derive macros. Includes global `--db` flag, all subcommand arguments, and appropriate defaults. Resolves the `--db` ambiguity for `serve` by relying solely on the global `--db` flag (no duplicate local flag).

tasks.title: CLI: main entrypoint & dispatch
tasks.description: Implement `src/main.rs` that parses CLI args using the `Cli` struct, resolves the database path (global `--db` or `~/.markman.db`), and dispatches to the appropriate storage or web functions. Handles output formatting for each subcommand: `added: <url>`, `[<id>] <url> | <desc> | tags: <tags>`, `removed: <id>`, and `listening on http://0.0.0.0:<port>`. Applies correct exit codes for all error cases. For `remove`, non-positive i64 values (zero or negative) are rejected at parse/validation time with code 2 matching the 'positive integer' error message.

tasks.title: Tests: storage unit tests
tasks.description: Add unit tests in `src/storage/tests.rs` (or inline in `src/storage/mod.rs`) covering add, list, list-with-query, remove, duplicate-URL error, and unknown-id error using an in-memory or temp-file SQLite database.

tasks.title: Tests: CLI integration tests
tasks.description: Add integration tests in `tests/cli.rs` that invoke the compiled binary with various argument combinations and assert stdout/stderr content and exit codes for all subcommands including edge cases (missing url, bad id, no bookmarks found).
